messages:
jamie (partnerships): Hey team — NimbusCore is ready to run the joint perf/W + throughput sweep. Want to align on the matrix and who owns what.
minh (eng-runtime): thanks — can we scope: models, seq len, batch, and quant configs? Also kernel knobs we want to test.
alex (NimbusCore HW): Nimbus will provide 6 boards, per-board power sensors, and a telemetry bucket. We can also give a patched kernel with our memprefetch patch for one cohort.
sofia (eng-ml): Suggested minimal matrix: GPT-7B and LLM-13B, seq 512/1024, batch 1/4/8, quant q4_0 + q8_0. Kernel variants: stock + nimbus-prefetch.
jamie (partnerships): timeline? we need a data drop for marketplace listing and a press snippet.
alex (NimbusCore HW): We can start runs Tue, need your run script by Monday EOD. We can host upload to s3://nimbuscore/bench/redwood-drop.
minh (eng-runtime): I'll own the runner orchestration and collection. Can you confirm telemetry schema? we need power, perf counters, and per-token latency hist.
alex (NimbusCore HW): telemetry schema here: https://nimbuscore.example.com/telemetry-spec (S3 access granted to redwood-temp). power: sampled 10Hz, perf counters: cycles, L3-miss, mem-bandwidth.
sofia (eng-ml): For quality/regression we should capture a small eval set (50 prompts) per model. I'll prepare the promptset and baseline outputs.
jamie (partnerships): action items: @minh create runner + CI job, @sofia create eval set, @alex provision boards + telemetry + tar location, partnerships will draft marketplace blurb.
minh (eng-runtime): working on runner. Proposed run command (WIP):
```
./bench-run --model gpt-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --quant q4_0 \
  --kernel-variant nimbus-prefetch --telemetry s3://nimbuscore/bench/redwood-run1 \
  --power-sample 10 --csv-out run1.csv
```
sofia (eng-ml): looks good. please include a --promptset flag so eval is attached.
alex (NimbusCore HW): we'll tag boards with IDs and TTL for runs. we prefer tests run during 09:00-18:00 PT to keep lab availability.
jamie (partnerships): Marketplace needs two numbers: sustainable perf (tokens/sec per watt) and 99p latency at p50 throughput. We should capture both.
minh (eng-runtime): agree. I'll compute perf/W = tokens/sec / average_power_w. Also export per-route latency buckets.
bench-bot: Reminder: run job template created: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/nimbus-perf (runs nightly to dry-run). :robot_face:
alex (NimbusCore HW): One more ask — allow kernel-debug logs to go to our secure bucket during the prefetched kernel runs. I opened infra ticket.
jamie (partnerships): Great. Next checkpoint Friday 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and draft marketplace copy after initial run results. :thumbsup:
minh (eng-runtime): Thanks — will post the runner PR this afternoon.
sofia (eng-ml): I'll upload promptset + eval harness link by tomorrow.
alex (NimbusCore HW): Boards are on the way to our lab — ETA 48h. Will ping when racked.
bench-bot: scheduled: Friday 10:00 PT sync added to calendar (channel: #partnerships).
